subject: Translate queued sword damage while the victim is already dying
description: Schema-12 `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_linux2/Profile_002/Continue/replay-004-session-0001.jsonl.zst` advanced through Task538's queued-damage fix and diverged after frame 8320 only on PC137: Original retained animation 105 `DyingSword` with command `ReceiveSwordDamage`, while Rust exposed animation 283 and `Wait`. Two same-frame cutting hits had executed in FIFO order. The first, from Soldier150, reduced life from 17 to zero and ran Kill; the second, from Soldier153, executed while life was already zero. Original `RHElementActorHuman::SetLifePoints` returns early for an already-dead human, preventing only a repeated Kill cascade (`original-code/RHelementactorhuman.cpp:10457-10464`). `Instruct(RECEIVE_SWORD_DAMAGE)` still calls `TranslateSwordDamage` for the second nonzero result (`original-code/RHelementactorhuman.cpp:1421-1425`, `1495-1502`); because the first dying order has not executed yet, posture remains Upright and the sword action selects `DyingSword` (`original-code/RHelementactorhuman.cpp:2528-2559`, `2628-2656`). Rust had incorrectly coupled the no-repeat-Kill return in `handle_post_damage` to an accepted-empty translation, terminating the second card and clearing the live command/order. Commit `f6fbd2674a36132cc9a748bae20f11e80699c617` keeps repeated Kill suppression but independently queues the source-authored dying/falling order and slope roll for an already-dead, non-push, non-parried hit whose live posture still supports combat translation. The strengthened `lethal_sword_hit_preserves_queued_second_damage_fifo` regression requires the second card to remain `InProgress`, own live `ReceiveSwordDamage`, and publish `DyingSword`; the Task269 grounded control `sword_damage_on_dying_pc_preserves_the_fresh_sprite_start` still terminates without overwriting its motion edge. Both focused tests, formatting, and diff checks pass. A freshly rebuilt optimized runner matches the linux2 Continue replay-004 representative and schema-14 Cyrdach Profile_156 Savegame_001 replay-009 through exact EOF.
